status: EXPERIMENTAL — NOT promoted to canonical; frozen v1 (symbolu/lightweight_phase) is unchanged and remains the negative baseline.

equations.gate: w_t = sigmoid(W_w h_t) in [0,1], causal (token only)
equations.readout: o_t^(b) = Re(q_phasor_t (.) S_t^(b)) / stopgrad(max(a_q (.) A_t^(b), eps)); fuse = W_fuse(concat_b o_t^(b))*aux_scale
equations.v1_special_case: one bank, gamma=1, w_t==1 (dense, no decay) == frozen v1

training_recipe: FocusModel = embed + small local window + variant + focus decoder; modes e2e (focus-decode CE + write-budget reg) or gate_sup (+ supervised write gate: write header, skip distractors). Adam lr 1e-3, ~250 steps, rho=0.10.
known_limitations: Shared gate writes the header to ALL banks incl. short-decay ones; the flattened multi-bank state buries the persistent bank's focus signal. Per-bank gates (route header->persistent) are the indicated fix.
